verses.text: Haxo ix yilan winhaj Jacob to wan sja winhaj Esaú yet' 400 swinak, ix spojanek' heb' unin winh t'a skal heb' ix ix, haton ix Lea yet' ix Raquel yet' pax heb' ix chawanh scriada heb' ix.
Ha heb' ix criada chi', ix b'ab'laj b'at heb' ix yet' yune' chi'. Ichato chi' ix b'at ix Lea yet' heb' yiko'. Tzak'anto ix b'at ix Raquel yet' winhaj José.
T'a elanhchamel ix b'ab'lajb'at winhaj Jacob t'a yichanh heb' ix. Ukel ix em nhojnaj winh masanto ix k'och winh t'a yichanh winh yuk'tak chi'.
Ix jawi lemnaj winhaj Esaú chi', ix och lak'naj winh t'a sjaj winh yuk'tak chi', ix och tz'ub'naj winh t'a sti' winh, ix ok' heb' winh schawanhil.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yilanoch heb' ix ix yet' heb' unin winhaj Esaú chi', ix sk'anb'an winh icha tik: --Ha juntzanh heb' tik, ¿mach ay yik heb'? xchi winh. --Wuninal heb', ix yak' Dios t'ayin yuj swach'k'olal, xchi winhaj Jacob chi'.
Ichato chi' ix snitzankot sb'a heb' ix criada yet' heb' yune' t'a yichanh winhaj Esaú chi', ix em nhojan heb' t'a sat lu'um.
Ix snitzanpaxkot sb'a ix Lea yet' heb' yune', ix empax nhojan heb'. Tzak'anto ix jawi winhaj José yet' ix snun, haton ix Raquel, ix empax nhojan heb'.

Ix sk'anb'an winhaj Esaú t'a winhaj Jacob chi' icha tik: --¿Tas tza na t'a yib'anh juntzanh nok' nok' ix in cha t'a yol b'e? xchi winh. --Ik yaj nok' smasanil yik tz'och junk'olal t'a ko kal, xchi winhaj Jacob chi'.
--Ma'ay wuk'tak, te tzijtum pax nok' wiko', kanokab' nok' het'ok, xchi winh.

Palta ix och ijan winhaj Jacob chi' yalan t'a winh icha tik: --Ma'ay wuk'tak, tato wach' in t'a ichanh, cha juntzanh silab' swak' tik t'ayach, icha wal to ha Dios swilochi ayik tzach wilan tik, yujto t'a wach'k'olalil ix in a cha'a.

Tzin tewi t'ayach to tza cha juntzanh silab' ix wik'kot t'ayach, yujto ha Dios ix el t'a sk'ol yak'an in b'eyumal tik, malaj jab'ok tas syak' palta t'ayin, xchi winhaj Jacob chi'. Ix ochnhej tean winh t'a winh yuk'tak chi', yuj chi' ix scha nok' silab' chi' winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Esaú chi' icha tik: --Ha tiknaik, koyek. Ha in tzin b'ab'laj t'a eyichanh, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Jacob chi': --Ach wuk'tak, ojtak to a heb' unin, k'un sk'unb'i heb', tzin na'anpax yuj nok' kalnel yet' nok' wakax nenetakto yune', tato tzin pech nok' ay smay junnhej k'ual scham nok' smasanil.
Yuj chi' wach' tzach b'ab'laj wu'uj. Ha inxo tik, k'ojank'olalnhej ol in b'atok, icha syal sb'ey heb' unin yet' nok' nok' tik. Olxo ach wilk'och t'a Seir, xchi winh.

--Yik'okab' icha tzal chi'. Syal skan jaywanhok heb' winh in chekab' tik yik skolwaj het'ok, xchi winhaj Esaú chi'. Palta ix yalan winhaj Jacob chi' icha tik: --Ma'ay, yuj wal Dios, manh ak' pensar wu'uj, xchi winh.
Ha t'a jun k'u chi', ix meltzaj winhaj Esaú t'a lum Seir.

Haxo winhaj Jacob, ix jakan winh t'a jun ak'lik. Hata' ix sb'o spat winh, ix sb'oanpax juntzanh yunetak lechpat winh b'aj ix och nok' smolb'etzal nok'. Yuj chi' Sucot ix yak' winh sb'iej jun lugar chi'.
Ayik ix paxta winhaj Jacob t'a Padán-aram masanto ix jawi winh t'a yol yik Canaán, malaj tas ix ik'an winh, wach' sk'ol winh ix jaxi. Ix sb'o'an scampamento winh t'a yichanhb'at chonhab' Siquem.
100 k'e'en plata ix yak' winh yik smanan jun lum lum chi' winh t'a heb' yuninal winhaj Hamor, winh ix ik'anel yich chonhab' Siquem. Hata' ix sb'ok'e scampamento winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix sb'oank'e jun altar winh, El-Elohe-Israel ix yak' winh sb'iej.
